plugin.description: Area timers and observed backpack currency quantities, with saved sessions and CSV export.
window.title: Area timer and currency
settings.town: Show summary in towns and hideouts
settings.scope: Counts positive changes in total backpack currency while sampled in combat areas. Existing items, towns, hideouts, loading, pause, lost focus and large panels are excluded from counting. The first safe sample after a gap establishes a new baseline.
settings.limits: This is observed backpack income, not total ground drops or profit. Spending between samples can hide income; dropping and picking up currency again can count again. Items gained while excluded are not recovered later. Gold and other wallet balances are not backpack items. Names come from the game client.
settings.timer: The timer excludes towns, hideouts, loading, Escape, manual pause and lost focus. Returning to the same area instance continues its timer. Campaign combat areas are also recorded. Restarting never counts offline time.
settings.save: Sessions save automatically every 10 seconds and when disabled. New session archives the current record. History is kept until you remove its files yourself; CSV exports contain per-area currency quantities.
status.inactive: Paused: loading, game menu or lost focus
status.invalid: Waiting for a consistent backpack sample
status.panel: Timer running; currency sampling paused while a panel is open
history.title: Currency session history
message.archived: Previous session archived; new session started.
settings.preview: Preview bar outside the game (real data)
settings.lock: Click-through bar (unlock to scroll map history)
settings.divine: Display value in Divine instead of Exalted
settings.price_help: Value uses LootValue's selected league/source cache (up to 24 hours old). Enable LootValue to refresh prices. A dash means no price data; * means an incomplete estimate. These are current estimated currency proceeds, not profit after map costs. Session time includes hideout time; average map time excludes it.
settings.price_missing: Waiting for matching, current LootValue prices
